description: In Panoply, a geo-mapped plot of the NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis monthly long-term mean air temperature data (variable 'air') is currently displayed using the default Equirectangular (Map1) projection. Change the map projection to 'Orthographic' using the plot controls. The Orthographic projection shows the globe as it appears from space. To do this, locate the 'Projection' dropdown in the plot window's controls (usually under the 'Map' tab or projection settings area), click on it, and select 'Orthographic' from the list. The plot should update to show the globe in an Orthographic (spherical) view.

natural_language.prompt: Change the map projection of the currently displayed air temperature plot from Equirectangular to Orthographic projection.
